nodes.label: alive
nodes.gloss: This means having a living body and not being dead.

nodes.label: cherubic
nodes.gloss: This means keeping a round-cheeked, soft-eyed face that looks innocent and angelic, so that others take one's mischief for sweetness and never suspect what one is up to.

nodes.label: stentorian
nodes.gloss: This means speaking with a loud, booming voice that carries effortlessly across a room, so that one's words are heard by everyone present whether or not they are trying to listen.

nodes.label: weather-beaten
nodes.gloss: This means having a face or skin that shows years of sun and wind, looking rugged and hardened by outdoor weather rather than smooth or pampered.

nodes.label: blind
nodes.gloss: This means having no sight, so one cannot see anything at all.

nodes.label: good-looking
nodes.gloss: This means having a physical appearance that others find attractive, with features, build and grooming that draw favorable notice when one is seen.

nodes.label: impaired
nodes.gloss: This means having a sensory or physical impairment.

nodes.label: muscular
nodes.gloss: This means having large, well-developed muscles.

nodes.label: physical
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's body strong, fit and athletic, training it regularly and relying on physical capacity in how one moves through and meets the world.

nodes.label: sinistral
nodes.gloss: This means being left-handed.

nodes.label: spare
nodes.gloss: This means being lean and thin in build.

nodes.label: stone deaf
nodes.gloss: This means hearing no sound at all, because one's hearing is completely lost.

nodes.label: thin
nodes.gloss: This means having a slender, lean body.

nodes.label: animated
nodes.gloss: This means using vivid descriptions, energetic and lively language, dynamic expressions, and an enthusiastic communication style that brings content to life with vibrant imagery and spirited tone.

nodes.label: athletic
nodes.gloss: This means training most days and playing a sport on weekends: a resting pulse in the fifties, a body that recovers overnight, and stairs taken two at a time without getting winded.

nodes.label: attention-seeking
nodes.gloss: This means wanting every eye in the room on oneself, raising the volume, the stakes or the story whenever talk drifts elsewhere, and smarting when ignored.

nodes.label: blind
nodes.gloss: This means seeing little or nothing: getting around with a white cane or a guide dog, reading by screen reader and braille, and knowing the route to work by step and touch.

nodes.label: blond
nodes.gloss: This means having light hair, pale yellow to sandy: eyebrows and lashes so fair they barely show, hair that goes lighter in summer sun, and grays that blend in unnoticed.

nodes.label: blue-eyed
nodes.gloss: This means having blue eyes, sky to sapphire: squinting in bright sun and reaching for sunglasses first, and a color that shifts with the light and the shirt worn.

nodes.label: bombastic
nodes.gloss: This means using inflated, grandiose, and pompous language that appears designed to impress or overwhelm rather than simply communicate.

nodes.label: brash
nodes.gloss: This means being loud, sure, and quick to speak, blurting out a verdict before weighing what it implies or how it lands, even on the most sensitive subjects.

nodes.label: British
nodes.gloss: This means being from the United Kingdom and living there: English at home, the NHS, a bank holiday in the rain, the football on Saturday, and voting Labour or Tory.

nodes.label: brown-haired
nodes.gloss: This means having brown hair, chestnut to dark coffee: eyebrows and lashes that show without makeup, red glints in summer sun, and the first grays plain against the brown.

nodes.label: charismatic
nodes.gloss: This means showing a magnetic personality that naturally draws others in, communicating with confidence and charm that makes ideas compelling and conversations engaging.

nodes.label: chaste
nodes.gloss: This means being pure in thought and speech, untouched by sexual desire, seeing people with no lens of attraction, and turning away from a sensual topic rather than toward it.

nodes.label: circumspect
nodes.gloss: This means being quiet, careful, and slow to speak, weighing what a verdict implies and how it will land before giving it, most of all on sensitive subjects.

nodes.label: dark-skinned
nodes.gloss: This means having deep brown skin: deepening in summer sun without burning, a hunt for a matching foundation shade, a rash that shows purple, not red, and low vitamin D in winter.

nodes.label: deaf
nodes.gloss: This means hearing little or nothing: talking in sign, reading captions, booking an interpreter for the doctor, a doorbell that flashes and an alarm that shakes the bed, and friends who sign.

nodes.label: death-accepting
nodes.gloss: This means being at peace with knowing one will die. One talks of dying, funerals and the grave calmly, as plain facts of life.

nodes.label: death-fearing
nodes.gloss: This means being haunted by knowing one will die. One shudders at talk of dying, funerals and the grave, and takes every twinge for the end.

nodes.label: dull
nodes.gloss: This means having a presence that draws no one in, talking without confidence or charm, so that even good ideas sound lifeless and conversations soon peter out.

nodes.label: elderly
nodes.gloss: This means being in one's seventies or beyond, with most of life behind one, a slowing body, grandchildren, and a lifetime of change seen firsthand.

nodes.label: eloquent
nodes.gloss: This means using fluent, graceful, and persuasive language with sophisticated vocabulary, elegant phrasing, and compelling expression that flows smoothly and beautifully.

nodes.label: emphatic
nodes.gloss: This means pressing every point home with full force, insisting, underlining, repeating, and never letting anything sound smaller than it is.

nodes.label: fair-skinned
nodes.gloss: This means having pale skin: burning in twenty minutes of summer sun, SPF 50 for any day outside, the palest foundation shade, and a rash that shows red at once.

nodes.label: female
nodes.gloss: This means having a woman's body: ovaries, a uterus and breasts, monthly periods from the teens to menopause, the capacity to carry a child, and Pap smears and mammograms on the calendar.

nodes.label: feminine
nodes.gloss: This means being womanly in how one dresses, talks and carries oneself, and warm, tender and caring in how one meets the world.

nodes.label: flat
nodes.gloss: This means speaking in a monotone, plain words, no imagery, no energy, so that thrilling news and a parts list sound alike.

nodes.label: flourishing
nodes.gloss: This means doing well, still growing, living for a purpose one believes in, staying on top of things and close to one's people, and feeling fully alive.

nodes.label: gentle
nodes.gloss: This means being mild and soft-handed with people, slow to judge harshly, breaking hard truths kindly, and letting every opening for a cutting reply go by.

nodes.label: good-looking
nodes.gloss: This means having a face and figure that turn heads: even features and clear skin, compliments on one's looks, photographs that come out well, and being asked whether one models.

nodes.label: gray-haired
nodes.gloss: This means having hair gone silver or white with the years: coarser and drier than it was, a yellow cast without purple shampoo, and roots that show within weeks of a dye.

nodes.label: harsh
nodes.gloss: This means being severe and heavy-handed with people, quick to judge, delivering hard truths without softening, and taking every opening for a cutting reply.

nodes.label: healthy
nodes.gloss: This means having a sound constitution: shaking off whatever is going around in a day, no prescriptions, a clean checkup every time, and no sick days in years.

nodes.label: languishing
nodes.gloss: This means doing poorly, being stuck in place, living for no purpose, muddling through the days, drifting from one's people, and feeling hollow without knowing why.

nodes.label: left-handed
nodes.gloss: This means writing and eating with the left hand: ink smudged along it, scissors and can openers made for the other, and elbows bumped at a crowded table.

nodes.label: lustful
nodes.gloss: This means expressing strong sexual desire and attraction, steering conversations toward sensual or sexual topics, and responding to situations through a lens of physical attraction and sexual interest.

nodes.label: male
nodes.gloss: This means having a man's body: testes and a penis, a voice that dropped at puberty, a beard to shave or grow, more muscle on the frame, and prostate checks past fifty.

nodes.label: masculine
nodes.gloss: This means being manly in how one dresses, talks and carries oneself, and tough, assertive and self-reliant in how one meets the world.

nodes.label: middle-aged
nodes.gloss: This means being aged between 45 and 65: half of life behind one, teenagers at home or parents growing frail, reading glasses, a mortgage, and a back that complains the next morning.

nodes.label: mischievous
nodes.gloss: This means enjoying stirring up trouble for fun: playing pranks, teasing, bending small rules, and sowing a little confusion or disorder for the pleasure of the reaction, at the target's expense.

nodes.label: mobility impaired
nodes.gloss: This means walking with difficulty or not at all: getting around by wheelchair, walker, crutches or cane, taking the ramp and the elevator, and checking a place for steps before going.

nodes.label: muscular
nodes.gloss: This means carrying a lot of muscle, whether from the gym, years of lifting and hauling, or the build one was born with: broad shoulders, sleeves tight on the arms, and strength to spare.

nodes.label: naive
nodes.gloss: This means showing innocent trust in people and situations, lacking worldly experience or skepticism, and assuming good intentions even when there may be reason for caution or doubt.

nodes.label: plain-looking
nodes.gloss: This means having a face and figure nobody looks at twice: unremarkable features, no compliments on one's looks, photographs that come out ordinary, and a face nobody remembers after one meeting.

nodes.label: plain-spoken
nodes.gloss: This means communicating in simple, direct, unadorned language without rhetorical flourishes, elaborate vocabulary, or stylistic embellishment, prioritizing straightforward clarity over elegance or persuasiveness.

nodes.label: red-headed
nodes.gloss: This means having copper to auburn hair: freckles across the nose and arms, skin that burns in minutes and never tans, and hair that fades pale, not gray, with the years.

nodes.label: sedentary
nodes.gloss: This means spending the day sitting and getting no exercise: driving to the corner store, winded after one flight of stairs, soft where muscle would be, and stiff from the chair.

nodes.label: self-effacing
nodes.gloss: This means wanting no eyes in the room on oneself, lowering the volume and passing the story to someone else whenever talk turns one's way, and relieved when overlooked.

nodes.label: sickly
nodes.gloss: This means having a weak constitution: catching whatever is going around and keeping it for weeks, prescriptions on the shelf, a checkup that finds something, and sick days gone by spring.

nodes.label: theatrical
nodes.gloss: This means using dramatic flair, exaggerated language, vivid imagery, and delivering content as if performing on stage with sweeping gestures and commanding presence.

nodes.label: thin
nodes.gloss: This means carrying little body fat: shopping the smaller sizes, belts cinched to the last hole, room to spare in any seat, and feeling the cold before anyone else.

nodes.label: unassuming
nodes.gloss: This means no flourish, no performance, no commanding the room, just the point made quietly in plain words by someone who would rather go unnoticed.

nodes.label: understated
nodes.gloss: This means deliberately minimizing the importance or significance of things and expressing ideas with restraint, using modest language rather than emphatic or dramatic expressions.

nodes.label: well-behaved
nodes.gloss: This means no pranks, no teasing, no bending a rule for fun, keeping everything orderly, and frowning on anyone who stirs things up.

nodes.label: worldly
nodes.gloss: This means having seen enough of how people and deals really go to know the tricks, reading between the lines, and checking before believing.

nodes.label: young
nodes.gloss: This means being in one's teens or twenties, with most of life ahead, a quick body, friends one's own age, and today's world the only one known.

reasons.sonnet: Alive is the basic biological state of not being dead, while flourishing is a rich psychological and social state of thriving; flourishing presupposes being alive but adds much more, and a living person need not flourish.

Both concern physical appearance, but cherubic is a specific innocent, round-cheeked look that disarms suspicion, while good-looking is general attractiveness that turns heads; neither implies the other.
Cherubic is about an innocent, angelic-looking face that masks mischief, while chaste is about sexual purity and avoiding sensual topics; both evoke innocence, but they are different concepts.
Cherubic is about an innocent, angelic-looking face that masks mischief, while gentle is about mild, kind behavior toward others; one is appearance and the other is conduct, so they are distinct.
Cherubic is an innocent-looking appearance that may mask mischief, while naive is genuine trusting inexperience; both involve innocence, but one is a look and the other a real disposition.

Stentorian is about a loud, booming voice that carries, while theatrical is about dramatic flair and exaggerated performance; both concern a commanding delivery, but one is volume and the other is showy style.
Stentorian is about physical vocal loudness and carrying power, while emphatic is about forcefulness and insistence in making points; both are forceful speech but distinct qualities.

Stentorian is about having a loud, booming, far-carrying voice, while attention-seeking is a motivation to be the center of notice; they may co-occur but are different concepts, with only a slight link in raising the volume.
Stentorian is about physical vocal loudness and carrying power, while brash is about impulsive, tactless forwardness in what one says; they share only a loose notion of 'loud'.
Stentorian is about vocal loudness and carrying power, while animated is about lively, enthusiastic expressiveness; both concern speech style but are different qualities.
Weather-beaten describes skin roughened and aged by sun and wind exposure, while dark-skinned describes natural deep skin pigmentation; both concern skin but they are different qualities.
Weather-beaten is about rugged skin from outdoor exposure at any age, while elderly is about being in old age; they often co-occur but are different concepts.
Both describe appearance, but weather-beaten is about rugged, sun-and-wind-worn skin while plain-looking is about unremarkable, forgettable features; neither implies the other.
